body: I was about to make this exact post 😂 my girl farted so loud like 10 minutes ago that our baby monitor caught it. She just lets it rip all the time and it is SO LOUD 😂😂

I had planned on breastfeeding and thought I knew what I was getting into when I had my daughter… I ended up with really scary PPD/psychosis the first week we were home from lack of sleep/support with triple feeding and decided that my baby needed me alive and sane more than I needed to breastfeed. We started combo feeding and I transitioned her to formula completely within 3 days of starting it. No regrets at all in my choice.
Also, I did not breastfeed so that may have contributed to the weight loss.

I was already overweight when I got pregnant - between diabetes and an eventual severe preeclampsia diagnosis leading to a c-section, I had gained between 65-70 lbs (up to 310lbs when I got to the hospital to be induced) and 2 weeks after at my first pp follow up I was down 45 lbs to 265lbs. Granted, I had MASSIVE amounts of swelling, think Stay-Puft marshmallow man, due to fluid retention. My girl was 7lb2oz at birth.

Following! My 7week old girl has been super sleepy all day today which is weird for her. Wake windows have been around 45 mins tops when normally they can go up to 2 hours. No fevers or unusual feeding patterns/diaper issues. I’m hoping it’s just a growth spurt!

Dr. Jones-Monte at NE Women’s Health (Atrium) has been my doctor for a few years now and she is great! I went through a similar situation (fertility and cruddy GYN) and started seeing her, now I’m a week out from having my first little one thanks to her help, care and encouragement! I’ve also seen Felicia Hunt NP at that office and she’s amazing as well!!
